_comment: Named rivalries involving Big 12 teams. Hand-curated, and the ONLY
hand-curated file in tiebreaker/data/ — everything else here is fetched.
It holds identity and nothing else: who plays whom, what the game is
called, and what they play for. Deliberately no first-played years, no
all-time series records and no 'played every year since' claims, because
this repository's games only go back to 2011 and none of that could be
checked against anything. Every number in a rivalry fact is computed from
the committed schedules and says the window it covers. A trophy's name is
a stable fact about the world; a series record is a moving one, and the
two do not belong in the same file.
`conference` is whether the pairing is a Big 12 game today. Most of these
are not: realignment left the Backyard Brawl, the Cy-Hawk, Bedlam and the
Border War outside the league, which is exactly what makes them worth
Team names must match data/teams.json and the CFBD names used in
games_*.json; tests/test_rivalries.py asserts that both sides of every
pairing are names this build actually knows.

rivalries.name: the Battle for the Victory Bell
